item.title: Preserve the Season: Stone Fruit — Sat Aug 1, 10:00 AM — Gather Sebastopol
item.description:
Part of our monthly Preserve the Season series, this hands-on workshop explores practical techniques for capturing the best of the harvest. Guided by Christina Connelly of Apple Blossom Acres, you’ll learn the fundamentals of home preservation while working with the freshest stone fruit available that week. In this workshop you’ll: * Learn the basics of home preservation and safe canning practices * Work with peak-season stone fruit selected for flavor and quality * Understand how fruit, sugar, acidity, and pectin work together in preserves * Make a seasonal jam, preserved fruit, and fruit-based beverage ingredient * Gain the confidence to continue preserving summer fruit at home You’ll leave with one jam, one preserved fruit and one preserved beverage and the skills to continue preserving the harvest at home.
Source: Sebastopol Calendar

item.title: Orchard Hike with Brooke Hazen at Gold Ridge Organic Farms — Sat Aug 1, 10:15 AM — Gold Ridge Organic Farms
item.description: Don’t just tour the farm — explore it alongside the very farmer who built it, Brooke Hazen, in this immersive, behind-the-scenes experience. Step into the heart of Gold Ridge Organic Farms for an orchard hike led by our founder and farmer, Brooke Hazen. With over two decades of dedication poured into these 88 acres of certified organic farmland, Brooke will guide you through the orchards and share the story of how he transformed this land into a thriving sanctuary for heirloom apples, olives, and citrus. Along the way, you’ll explore our 70+ heirloom apple varieties and 21 olive cultivars, learn about our organic farming practices, and get your questions answered by the person who knows this land better than anyone Please Note: This is a moderately challenging walk over uneven, rugged terrain with gentle hills and light elevation gain. Warm up in the sauna, cool down with a plunge, and relax riverside in the golden evening light. Want to make it a floating picnic party? This is Sonoma County river culture at its finest: movement, nature, community, wellness, and good vibes — all in one unforgettable afternoon. item.description:
Matt Jaffe is an indie rock & roll singer/songwriter from San Francisco. Cutting his teeth on countless open mics around the Bay, Matt started taking music \(a little bit\) more seriously when Jerry Harrison of Talking Heads offered to produce his first record. Since then, Matt has continued to churn out more songs than he can remember the words to, perform on stages throughout the land \(opening and/or touring with the likes of Mavis Staples, Wilco, Bob Weir, Jackie Greene, Chuck Prophet, Melissa Etheridge, and Blues Traveler\), and collaborate with Tom Higgenson of the Plain White T's. Inspired by the likes of Elvis Costello, Tom Petty and Stephin Merritt, Matt is continuously writing and recording to build a songbook that honors his heroes. Along with serving on Bread & Roses Board of Directors, he is currently rolling out his 7th studio album, Gone Enough to Miss.

item.title: Banda Machos & Banda Toro & Banda Vallarta Show & Banda Zarape — Sun Aug 2, 2:00 PM — RODEO SANTA ROSA
item.description:
Banda Machos made its debut with the release of a cassette format album called Serían las Dos. The group's breakthrough came after issuing Sangre de Indio, featuring a style known as la quebradita, popularized in Los Angeles' Latin circuit in the early '90s. In 1993, Banda Machos was awarded by Univisión's Lo Nuestro for Revelation of the Year in the Mexican/Regional category, achieving a Furia Musical award for Best Mexican Band in 1995. Banda Machos' "ZapaMambo" was featured in the movie My Family, produced by Francis Ford Coppola in 1994. The group continued steadily releasing new material throughout the '90s and into the new millennium, usually issuing multiple albums in one year. Banda Machos released 20 Mil Heridas in early 2006, which was subsequently nominated for a Best Banda Album Grammy. ~ Drago Bonacich, All Music Guide
http://www.vh1.com/artists/az/banda\_machos/bio.jhtml

item.title: Community Town Hall Meeting — Mon Aug 3, 6:00 PM — Griffin Academy Middle & High Schools
item.description:
The Vallejo Police Department invites community members to attend a Community Town Hall Meeting regarding the officer-involved shooting that occurred on July 20, 2026.
The purpose of this Town Hall meeting is to provide information regarding the incident, explain the investigative and review processes that follow an officer-involved shooting, and answer questions from the community.
